terms.statement: Envelope link to the particular paraphrased InformationArtifact; not a new native relation.
terms.evidenceItem: Envelope link to the specific passage acting as EvidenceItem; not an assertion of evidential truth.
terms.sourceLocator: Edition-qualified PDF/table/row locator; shared by the record and its passage metadata.
terms.interpretationOrigin: Explicit assistant-paraphrase origin; does not imply primary author wording or owner acceptance.

external.http://purl.org/dc/terms/source: DOI identity of the inspected source on record and evidence item; not independent corroboration
external.http://purl.org/dc/terms/description: Brief original assistant paraphrase, not a source quotation

interpretation: Query projection for source trace inspection, not complete native managed-instance admission. Explicit record/native joins plus caller-known frozen cohort checks prevent cross-record/source/locator reassignment. No inference, identity normalization or remote query.
unknowns: Missing or conflicting metadata is preserved in the raw graph and rejected for this named trace task; no invented repair or case promotion.
limits: Coherent but false metadata cannot be disproved by SPARQL syntax. Frozen independently authored joins and primary-source inspection bind this finite cohort; source truth and owner semantic acceptance remain separate.
